reference_sql:
WITH promo_counts AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_promotions
  FROM promotion_products
  GROUP BY product_id
),
product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT pc.product_id, pc.n_promotions, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units
FROM promo_counts pc
LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = pc.product_id
alternatives: WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY product_id) SELECT pp.product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_promotions, COALESCE(MAX(u.units), 0) AS units FROM promotion_products pp LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = pp.product_id GROUP BY pp.product_id

WITH promo_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(promo_id) AS n_promotions FROM promotion_products GROUP BY 1), product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT pc.product_id, pc.n_promotions, SUM(COALESCE(u.units, 0)) AS units FROM promo_counts pc LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = pc.product_id GROUP BY pc.product_id, pc.n_promotions

solver.query:
WITH listed AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_promotions
  FROM promotion_products
  GROUP BY product_id
), product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT l.product_id, l.n_promotions, COALESCE(pu.units, 0) AS units
FROM listed l
LEFT JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id = l.product_id
